title: Quick Turkish-Style Lamb Doner Kebab
description: A simplified version of the classic Turkish dish, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This recipe uses thinly sliced lamb and a flavorful spice blend to create a delicious and tender kebab.

ingredients.name: Quick Turkish spice blend
ingredients.notes: Available at most Middle Eastern grocery stores

ingredients.name: Doner kebab meat (lamb or beef)
ingredients.notes: Available at most Middle Eastern grocery stores

instructions: In a small bowl, mix together the Quick Turkish spice blend and olive oil.
Brush the spice blend mixture onto both sides of the lamb slices.
Grill the lamb slices for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Once the lamb is cooked, let it rest for a few minutes before slicing it thinly against the grain.
Warm the pita bread by wrapping it in foil and heating it in the oven for a few minutes.
Assemble the kebabs by placing a few slices of the lamb onto each pita bread, along with some crumbly feta cheese, lettuce, tomatoes, red onion, and cucumber.
Drizzle the tops of the kebabs with a little olive oil and serve immediately.
Optional: Top with parsley and serve with extra pita bread on the side.
